H1144L.short: The Benjamin Gate was a gate in Jerusalem, associated with the tribe of Benjamin.

H1144M.name: Benjamin Gate
H1144M.brief: Gate in Jerusalem's wall, mentioned in Zechariah's prophecy.
H1144M.short: The Benjamin Gate was a gate in Jerusalem's wall, mentioned in Zechariah's prophecy about the city's restoration. (<ref="Zechariah 14:10">Zechariah 14:10</ref>)

H1168A.name: Baal
H1168A.short: Baal-berith or El-berith, meaning "Lord of the Covenant" or "God of the Covenant," was a Canaanite deity worshipped by the Israelites in Shechem during the time of the judges (<ref="Judges 8:33; 9:4, 46">Judges 8:33; 9:4, 46</ref>).

H1170.name: Baal-berith
H1170.brief: Canaanite god of fertility and weather
H1170.short: Baal, a Canaanite god of fertility and weather, and Peor, a Moabite god, were worshipped by the Israelites, leading them into idolatry and disobedience to the Lord.

H1162H.name: Boaz
H1162H.brief: One of two bronze pillars in Solomon's Temple
H1162H.short: Boaz was the name given to one of the two bronze pillars that stood at the entrance of Solomon's Temple (<ref="1Ki.7.21; 2Ch.3.17">1Ki.7.21; 2Ch.3.17</ref>).
